latest.name: Gamer Social Club — Well Dweller Walkthrough

entries.effect: 在坚实地面蓄力发射火柴，踩上火柴可获得额外高度。
entries.effectEn: Launch a charged matchstick from firm ground and use it as a foothold for extra height.
entries.acquisition: 从猎人小屋中央帐篷往右进邮箱房，借移动铁笼下降。到底后往右，避开吊笼下的落下陷阱，从右侧缺口下去。跳过下一段铁笼，再从下方出口落到更低一层。沿路找到鸟巢，拾取悬浮的能力蛋并完成弹弓教学。
entries.acquisitionEn: Go right from the central Hunter’s Cabin tent to the mailbox room and ride the moving cage down. At the bottom, head right past the falling trap below the hanging cage and drop through the gap. Jump across the next set of cages and drop again. Follow the passage to the nest, take the floating Ability Egg and finish the Slingshot tutorial.

entries.effect: 贴墙按跳跃攀爬，初期受耐力限制。
entries.effectEn: Use jump against a wall to climb; the initial version consumes stamina.
entries.acquisition: 击败沼泽虫群后，从战场右侧出去并下落，在下层鸟巢取能力蛋。完成攀爬教学后，继续往右，用刚学到的能力攀上右墙进入下一间。沿这条路可继续前往夜之庭园东侧拿帐篷传送。
entries.acquisitionEn: After defeating the Swarm in the Bog, exit the arena to the right and drop down to the nest for the Ability Egg. Finish the Climb tutorial, then continue right and climb the wall into the next room. Follow this route into eastern Night Garden for Tent Travel.

entries.effect: 在上升气流中按住跳跃飞行。
entries.effectEn: Hold jump in an updraft to ride it.
entries.acquisition: 从排水道中央帐篷向右穿过气流和尖刺，在右侧出口前沿平台下落。避开尖刺下到底层，右转清掉战斗房里的四个敌人。向右进入下一间，再次下落并往右找到能力蛋，完成教学。
entries.acquisitionEn: Go right from the central Drains tent through the wind and spikes. Drop down the platforms before the right exit, avoid the spikes and turn right at the bottom. Defeat the four enemies, continue right to the next room, then drop and go right again to find the Ability Egg and finish the tutorial.

entries.effect: 空中按住跳跃，可短暂悬停。
entries.effectEn: Hold jump in midair to hover briefly.
entries.acquisition: 拾荒者被带走后往右走，到尽头下落。沿下层走到底，攀上平台再往左找鸟巢。拾取能力蛋并完成悬停教学。
entries.acquisitionEn: After Looter is taken away, go right and drop at the far end. Follow the lower passage, climb the platforms and turn left to the nest. Take the egg and finish the Hover tutorial.

entries.effect: 取消普通墙面攀爬的耐力限制。
entries.effectEn: Wall climbing no longer runs out of stamina.
entries.acquisition: 从深海巨型骷髅入口到帐篷，再往右挑战 The Colony。救出针儿和刺儿并看完团聚剧情后，回码头船坞找 Barge 领取。
entries.acquisitionEn: Reach the Deep tent through the giant skull and go right to face The Colony. Rescue Thimble and Thistle, finish their reunion and return to Barge at the Docks shipyard for the upgrade.

entries.effect: 攀墙时把火柴插进墙面，辅助攀升。
entries.effectEn: Plant the matchstick in a wall while climbing to help you ascend.
entries.acquisition: 击败玩偶师之镜后，往西救出玛格达。继续到附近的能力巢穴，拾取蛋并完成教学，就能在攀墙时把火柴插进墙里作落脚点。
entries.acquisitionEn: After defeating Dollmaker’s Mirror, go west and rescue Magda. Take the egg from the nearby ability nest and finish the tutorial to learn how to plant a matchstick foothold while climbing.

entries.effect: 先向下砸地，再立即按住跳跃高速腾空。
entries.effectEn: Slam the ground, then immediately hold jump to soar.
entries.acquisition: 击败女王并完成庆祝剧情后，回战场上方与拾荒者交谈，敲天花板拉杆进入寝室。集齐 32 件饰物后打开寝室西门，拾取鸟巢里的能力蛋并完成教学。学会后在能力蛋鸟巢处腾空，到上方房间拾取神秘标记，在地图上显示五处灵魂碎片入口。
entries.acquisitionEn: After defeating the Queen and finishing the celebration, speak to Looter above the arena and strike the ceiling lever to enter the chambers. Collect all 32 trinkets to open the western door, take the Ability Egg and complete its tutorial. Then Soar from the egg’s nest to the room above for Mysterious Markings, which mark the five Spirit Fragment entrances.

entries.effect: 打开地图，选中已发现的帐篷，按住画面提示的按键传送。
entries.effectEn: Open the map, select a discovered tent and hold the indicated input to travel.
entries.acquisition: 击败虫群后向右下落，完成攀爬教学。继续往右爬墙，清掉下一间的敌人，再走右上出口进入夜之庭园东侧。攀上右墙即可拿到帐篷传送。
entries.acquisitionEn: After defeating the Swarm, go right and drop down to complete the Climb tutorial. Continue right up the wall, clear the enemies in the next room and take the upper-right exit into eastern Night Garden. Climb the wall on the right for Tent Travel.

entries.effect: 开放码头水下载具及其入口，可驾驶载具探索水域。
entries.effectEn: Unlock docked water vessels and their access gates for underwater exploration.
entries.acquisition: 收齐码头三块门石，开门击败深海生物并救出船员。继续前往篝火，听完船员和 Barge 的对话后可驾驶载具。
entries.acquisitionEn: Collect the three Docks gate stones, open the gate and defeat the Creature from the Deep to rescue the crew member. Continue to the campfire and finish the conversation with Barge to gain vessel access.

entries.effect: 驾驶水下载具时发射鱼雷，用于破坏特定墙体和攻击敌人。
entries.effectEn: Fire torpedoes from the Water Vessel to break designated walls and attack enemies.
entries.acquisition: 从码头帐篷向右下到底层登上载具。沿右侧下潜，向右到底后折向左继续下潜，沿通道取得鱼雷。
entries.acquisitionEn: Board the vessel below and to the right of the Docks tent. Dive on the right side, go as far right as possible, then turn left and dive again. Follow the passage to Torpedo.

entries.effect: 用钥匙打开地图上以金锁标出的金门。拾荒者的四件零件分别在墓谷、干涸城堡、排水道和沼泽的门后。
entries.effectEn: Open the gates marked with gold padlocks. Looter’s four parts are behind gates in Graven Valley, Desiccated Castle, the Drains and the Bog.
entries.acquisition: 救出针儿和刺儿后，回码头船坞向 Barge 学无限攀爬。上到码头第一处帐篷的上一层，进第二处帐篷旁的旧靴子。与低语者对话，接下修复拾荒者的任务并拿到金门钥匙。
entries.acquisitionEn: After rescuing Thimble and Thistle, learn Endless Climb from Barge at the Docks shipyard. Go one level above the first Docks tent and enter the old boot beside the second tent. Speak to Whisper to start Looter’s repair quest and receive the key.

entries.effect: 显著降低存档帐篷内的购买价格。
entries.effectEn: Receive a substantial discount on purchases inside save tents.
entries.acquisition: 完成女王战后的庆祝剧情，回战场上方与拾荒者交谈，敲天花板拉杆开门。金币就在寝室内的桌上。
entries.acquisitionEn: After the post-battle celebration, speak to Looter above the Queen’s arena and strike the ceiling lever. Pick up the coin from the table inside the chambers.
